messages:
maria: Hey team — onboarding convo with OpenForge AI. They want to list an open LLM on cloud marketplaces and bundle HW SKUs. Quick Q: can we accept their suggested dual-license (Apache 2.0 + a restrictive commerce addendum)?
raj: dual-license + commerce addendum usually ok but need clarity on redistribution rights and liability. does the addendum explicitly block rehosting in our Dedicated offering?
elena: they said no rehosting to third-party marketplaces, but allowed our Dedicated and Private deployments. language is fuzzy. snippet they sent: ```Distribution: permitted to distribute in binary form for internal use; redistribution to third-party marketplaces prohibited without express consent.```
sam: that reads like a marketplace-block, which conflicts with our typical marketplace SKU flow. We need permission to list their model in our hosted catalog + marketplace bundles.
liz-legal: @maria can you get the exact addendum clause? two things we care about: 1) right for Redwood to sublicense (for marketplace listing) 2) ability to include in HW+model bundles/reseller SKUs.
maria: pasted clause above. I flagged the wording and asked if 'third-party marketplace' includes our marketplace and OEM partners. waiting on clarification.
raj: also ask about export controls / ECCN and whether they will provide an export classification or cold path for disallowed countries. marketplace onboarding needs that for compliance checks.
onboard-bot: [system] checklist: model_artifacthash ok, license_doc uploaded, export_check pending, attestation missing.
elena: from infra side, FedRAMP-requesting customers ask that model provenance and attestations are available in our Private deployment manifests. If they want FedRAMP compatibility, we need a signed attestation and scannable provenance. Can they provide that?
maria: asked them for: 1) explicit license text for addendum, 2) export classification, 3) provenance attestation, 4) a short allowed-usage blurb we can show on the marketplace page. ETA EOD PST.
sam: if they refuse sublicensing for marketplace, we can still offer Dedicated-only availability but that kills co-marketing and marketplace revenue. Heads-up to GTM.
liz-legal: rough fallback language we can propose: ```Redwood may sublicense the Model to cloud marketplace partners solely to enable hosting and distribution on Redwood-managed marketplace offerings. Such sublicenses do not permit further redistribution to third-party marketplaces without Provider consent.``` Send to provider as suggestion.
raj: also propose an indemnity carveout for export/usage violations and clarify support SLAs for quantized weights.
maria: good. I'll send the suggested clause + ask for ECCN + attestation. cc @elena for FedRAMP bits.
elena: if they can sign attestation + ECCN, Private + Dedicated + Marketplace listing is viable. If not, we should prepare Marketplace-only 'Viewer' SKU (inference-only via hosted API) that doesn't include weights to respect redistribution limits.
sam: agree. Viewer SKU could be quicker to launch while legal finishes. Product: need SKU name and pricing guardrails.
maria: action items: @liz-legal draft a short patch clause for sublicensing (done), @raj draft indemnity/export language, @elena confirm FedRAMP artifact checklist, I'll send to provider and report back.
liz-legal: copying proposed clause into the thread. happy to prep redlines.
raj: I'll draft indemnity lines by lunchtime.
maria: cool — will ping when provider replies. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
